episodes.synopsis: Aging superhero Kotetsu, known as Wild Tiger, worries that he may lose his job on the show "Hero TV" when his sponsor company changes hands.
episodes.title: All's Well That Ends Well

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu and Barnaby are paired up, but their differing methods prevent them from working as a team, leading to danger for Kotetsu's daughter.
episodes.title: A Good Beginning Makes a Good Ending.

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu reluctantly participates in a documentary about Barnaby, and they're both forced into action when they learn a bomb has been planted.
episodes.title: Many a True Word is Spoken in Jest

episodes.synopsis: Ice-wielding superhero Blue Rose decides to leave the world of "Hero TV" to go back to her old life as a teenage girl named Karina who loves to sing.
episodes.title: Fear is Often Greater Than the Danger

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu holds a big surprise birthday party for Barnaby with the other heroes; an expensive diamond known as the "Tears of Hercules" is stolen.
episodes.title: Go for Broke!

episodes.synopsis: Fire Emblem is suspected of murder after criminals arrested by Barnaby are found burned to death by peculiar blue flames in their prison cell.
episodes.title: Fire is a Good Servant But a Bad Master

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu criticizes Barnaby for allowing a NEXT to kill the culprit they were chasing; Barnaby reveals his search for the clue to his parents' killer.
episodes.title: The Wolf Knows What the Foul Beast Thinks

episodes.synopsis: Stern Bild doesn't have capital punishment, but Lunatic's act of killing criminals begins to win support of the people, who praise him as an antihero.
episodes.title: There is Always a Next Time

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu is assigned to baby-sit an infant, who takes a liking to a tomboy named Dragon Kid. The next day, Dragon Kid and the baby go missing.
episodes.title: Spare the Rod and Spoil the Child

episodes.synopsis: Barnaby has finally tracked down the whereabouts of his parents' killer; Kotetsu runs into trouble on the way to visiting his daughter.
episodes.title: The Calm Before the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Ouroboros demands the release of the man Barnaby was investigating, and then starts attacking the structural columns supporting Stern Bild.
episodes.title: The Die is Cast

episodes.synopsis: Jake challenges each of the heroes to fights, stating that he will surrender if he loses but will destroy a column supporting the city if he wins.
episodes.title: Take Heed of the Snake in the Grass

episodes.synopsis: After the other heroes fail to defeat Jake, Barnaby steps forward to protect Stern Bild and its people -- and to get revenge for his parents' death.
episodes.title: Confidence is a Plant of Slow Growth

episodes.synopsis: Ten months after their epic battle with terrorist Jake Martinez, Tiger and Barnaby are slated to form a special unit with Blue Rose.
episodes.title: Love Is Blind

episodes.synopsis: When Sky High falls in love with a woman he meets at a park, he turns to Fire Emblem, Blue Rose and Dragon Kid for advice on how to get close to her.
episodes.title: The Sky's the Limit ...

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu doesn't like the reason Ben gives him for the recent boosts in his power; Yuri, aka Lunatic, is haunted by a past incident.
episodes.title: Truth Lies at the Bottom of the Well

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu takes a vacation to his hometown, where he confesses his fears to his brother and makes a tough decision to keep his promise to his late wife.
episodes.title: Blood is Thicker Than Water

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu tries to tell Barnaby that he's retiring, but he's interrupted with news that Kriem has come out of her coma.
episodes.title: Ignorance is Bliss

episodes.synopsis: To help Barnaby, Kotetsu suggests they retrace Barnaby's steps the day of his parents' murder, but it doesn't produce the results they hoped for.
episodes.title: There's No Way Out

episodes.synopsis: Samantha wants to meet with Kotetsu regarding the new information she found, but he is called away for a sudden assignment.
episodes.title: Full of Courtesy, Full of Craft.

episodes.synopsis: Framed for a crime he didn't commit and pursued by the other heroes, Kotetsu is cornered, but a familiar face appears.
episodes.title: Heaven Helps Those Who Help Themselves

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu puts his plan to clear his name into action. Meanwhile, Barnaby is on his way to join the rest of the heroes.
episodes.title: Bad Luck Often Brings Good Luck

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu and Barnaby are finally reunited, but the rest of the heroes are taken hostage by Maverick, who holds them in the Justice Tower.
episodes.title: Misfortunes Never Come Singly

episodes.synopsis: Kotetsu and Barnaby take on H-01 despite having to wait for their powers to recharge, while the rest of the heroes must make a tough decision.
episodes.title: Nothing Ventured, Nothing Gained.

episodes.synopsis: The heroes suffer a stunning loss and must mourn a fallen peer, while Barnaby finally encounters his parents' killer one-on-one.
episodes.title: Eternal Immortality.
